ideas.title: Sprint Reflection Buddy
ideas.summary: A focused-work timer that pairs each 90-minute session with AI-generated reflection questions and a personalized improvement plan, stored entirely in your browser.
ideas.description: A minimalist focused-work timer that pairs each 90-minute deep-work session with AI-powered retrospectives. Before starting, you set a specific goal; when the session ends, Claude generates 3 targeted reflection questions based on your stated goal, then distills your answers into a 5-bullet improvement plan for your next sprint. All data stays local in the browser with no account required.
keyFeatures: Pre-sprint goal-setting with AI-generated scope-check nudge (is this goal realistic in 90 minutes?)
Post-sprint adaptive reflection prompts dynamically generated from your stated goal
Weekly heatmap showing session frequency and self-reported output quality over time
Export full sprint log as markdown for journaling or sharing with a mentor
ideas.techStack: Vite + React + Tailwind + Claude API + localStorage (no backend or account required)
ideas.whyInteresting: Pomodoro timers have been around forever but none offer personalized AI coaching tied to each session's specific goal, making this a tangible upgrade that could ship in a weekend.
ideas.inspiredBy: HN 'Ask HN: What are you working on? (June 2026)' productivity tool discussions (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48528779)

ideas.title: GPU Parallel Puzzler
ideas.summary: A browser-based puzzle game where students configure visual thread blocks on a simplified GPU model to solve data challenges, learning parallel computing concepts level by level.
ideas.description: A browser-based educational puzzle game where students solve data transformation challenges by visually configuring 'thread blocks' in a simplified GPU model. Each of 12+ levels introduces one parallel computing concept (SIMD lanes, shared memory, thread synchronization, memory coalescing) and auto-grades solutions on correctness plus a 'parallelism efficiency score.' An AI hint system explains in plain language why a student's approach is or is not GPU-friendly.
keyFeatures: Drag-and-drop thread block configurator with animated parallel execution timeline
Side-by-side CPU vs. GPU performance simulation for each solved puzzle
Claude-powered hint system that diagnoses common parallelism mistakes and suggests fixes
Auto-grading rubric export so instructors can use this as a graded lab assignment
Student progress dashboard via Supabase for classroom tracking
ideas.techStack: Vite + React + WebGPU (WebGL fallback for older browsers) + Claude API + Supabase
ideas.whyInteresting: WebGPU is now a stable W3C standard in every major browser, making GPU-accelerated education finally feasible without plugins; parallel computing is one of the most persistent skill gaps in CS graduates and there are almost no interactive tools that make it approachable.
ideas.inspiredBy: HN Show HN 'Build a GPU' game (June 2026 front page) and WebGPU reaching W3C standard status across all major browsers

ideas.title: Classroom Automation Recipes
ideas.summary: A no-code visual workflow builder for educators that lets instructors automate repetitive classroom tasks (grading drafts, nudging late students, summarizing discussions) using drag-and-drop recipe blocks connected to their LMS.
ideas.description: A visual no-code workflow builder purpose-built for educators that lets instructors design automated classroom routines using drag-and-drop 'recipe blocks.' Blocks cover common tasks: AI-grade a submission draft, send a personalized nudge to a student who has not submitted, summarize a discussion thread, generate a quiz from lecture notes, or route a student question to the right TA. Workflows trigger on LMS events such as new submission, discussion post, or grade release.
keyFeatures: 20+ pre-built recipe templates for common instructor workflows (late submission nudge, office hours summary, quiz generator from slides)
LMS webhook connectors for Canvas, Moodle, and Gradescope
AI processing block using Claude API for summarize, grade-draft, generate, and classify operations
Run-log dashboard showing every workflow execution with the AI output for instructor review before any action is final
Dry-run mode to preview exactly what a recipe would do before activating it in a live class
ideas.techStack: React + Flask + Supabase + Claude API (workflow engine inspired by n8n patterns)
ideas.whyInteresting: Instructors spend enormous time on repetitive administrative tasks that AI can handle; this lowers the barrier from 'AI sounds useful' to 'AI is actively running my class workflows today' without requiring any coding knowledge.
ideas.inspiredBy: n8n's explosive 2026 growth as an AI-native workflow automation platform with 400+ integrations, and the gap between powerful automation tools and typical instructor technical literacy (https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/187143)
